tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: Page ground at the bottom of every screen; the lower stop of the screen gradient.

tokens.name: screen-top
tokens.usage: Upper stop of the screen gradient, behind the search bar and tabs.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Soft radial light in the top-left corner of the screen. Never behind text that needs contrast.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Poster placeholders, avatar discs and other solid fills that sit on the screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the lighter end of placeholder gradients.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Resting fill of buttons, chips, the search field, download cards and picker rows.

tokens.name: glass-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of a chosen tab or chip, a focused wide card, and progress tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: control borders, card outlines, placeholder edges.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on screen, surface, glass and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: section headings, details lines, resting tab labels. On screen and surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Card metadata (year, rating, size) and search placeholder text. On screen, surface and glass; at least 4.5:1 there.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The one focus colour: fill of a focused pill control and the ring around a focused card. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: on-focus
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a focus fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Download progress and picked episodes. A mark colour: progress fills, pick discs.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icons on an accent fill (the tick in a pick disc).

tokens.name: ready
tokens.usage: Downloaded: the Ready badge, the status pill text and the have-all disc.

tokens.name: on-ready
tokens.usage: Text and the tick on a ready fill.

tokens.name: ready-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind ready text in the status pill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: stalled downloads, section notes, partly downloaded seasons, a nearly full disk. On screen, surface and glass.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and missing episodes. On screen and glass. Teletext red fails on its blue surface: keep it on black there.

tokens.name: danger-on-focus
tokens.usage: Label of a focused destructive button, on the focus fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Darkens a backdrop behind text on the details page.

groups.name: App
groups.note: One family, Outfit, at four weights. Nothing smaller than 12px: it is read from the couch.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The title on a details page. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: the episode picker, the downloads screen, dialog titles.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name beside the search field. Nowhere else.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Row titles above card rows, set in capitals, in ink-dim.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A former government operative renowned for his stealth, Jack Cole is now a Los Angeles police detective.
styles.usage: Plots, dialog text and messages. Keep lines under 70 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips and picker rows.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles under posters and on download cards. One line, ellipsised.

styles.name: card-meta
styles.usage: Year, rating, size and quality under a card title, in ink-faint.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Text inside the Ready / In library badge and the status pill.

groups.name: Themes
groups.note: Faces for the three concept themes. Not in the app yet.

styles.name: grindhouse-display
styles.usage: Grindhouse titles and row headings, in capitals.

styles.name: grindhouse-body
styles.sample: One of them is a goblin.
styles.usage: Grindhouse plots and metadata: a press-kit typewriter.

styles.name: rewind-spine
styles.usage: Rewind titles, like a VHS box spine.

styles.name: rewind-osd
styles.usage: Rewind labels, badges and headings, like a VCR's on-screen display.

styles.name: teletext
styles.usage: Every line of text in the Teletext theme.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Sizes are dp on the TV: the screen is 960 × 540.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tabs and chips; badge inset from a poster's corner.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a card's art and its title; between picker rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside download cards and dialogs; small button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding; between the buttons row and the delete row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between the details column and the poster.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right edge of every screen. Rows scroll inside it, so the focused card never touches the TV's edge.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Between cards in a row.

tokens.name: row-gap
tokens.usage: Between rows of cards.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Badges, download thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Posters, picker rows, focus rings around posters.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Download cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, the search field, the status pill.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Under a focused card or button, lifting it toward the viewer.

size.note: Fixed sizes of controls and cards, in dp.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Tabs, chips, the quality chip and the delete buttons.

tokens.name: control-l
tokens.usage: Primary buttons: Add film, Download all, Done.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: The search field.

tokens.name: poster-w
tokens.usage: Poster card width (2:3).

tokens.name: poster-h
tokens.usage: Poster card height (2:3).

tokens.name: download-w
tokens.usage: Download card width.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Cast photo disc.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width of the ring around a focused card.

scale.note: How much a focused element grows.

tokens.name: focus-scale
tokens.usage: Focused posters and cast photos.

tokens.name: focus-scale-wide
tokens.usage: Focused buttons, download cards and other wide elements, so their edges stay on screen.
